//overrides: Force Next's bundled sharp/postcss to patched versions. Next ships older copies (sharp <0.35.0 / postcss <8.5.10) that npm audit can only 'fix' by downgrading Next to 9.3.3; these are build-time only (static export, images unoptimized) so pinning the patched versions is safe. postcss is scoped under 'next' (nested override) because a root postcss override collides with the direct devDependency (EOVERRIDE), and $postcss=^8 would not bump Next's pinned 8.4.31. brace-expansion is pinned to ^5.0.12 (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr, GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p: DoS, affect <5.0.12): it is a transitive dep of ESLint's minimatch (devDependency, lint-time only) whose 1.x line has no patched release, so a global pin is the only fix short of a breaking eslint@10 upgrade; the expand() API is unchanged across majors. minimatch under @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree is forced to ^11.0.1 (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, affects >=7.0.0 <11.0.1): typescript-estree pins ^10.2.2 and npm audit's only 'fix' is downgrading @typescript-eslint to 6.15.0, which breaks the eslint@9 peer range; minimatch 11 keeps the same named minimatch() API.
